submitted.rationale: XRD shows rutile-type CuSb2O6 as the main phase at index 10 (Cu 0.35) and index 6 (Cu 0.50). Index 6 also has small peaks from the Cu-rich secondary phase that dominates index 2. Index 15 is Sb-oxide-rich. EQE was 0.0738% at index 6, 0.0365% at index 10 and 0.0210% at index 4. So EQE peaks near the Cu-rich edge of the CuSb2O6 single-phase field and drops once the Cu-rich secondary phase takes over.

rejected.reason: Measured EQE 0.0365%, half of index 6 (near-stoichiometric CuSb2O6)
Measured EQE 0.0210%; in the mixed-phase region with the Cu-rich secondary phase
XRD: mainly a Cu-rich secondary phase, the trend suggests low EQE
XRD: mixed with Sb-oxide phases; EQE falls toward the Sb-rich end
